gaps: Best months and months to avoid: no source found. The Ratnagiri and Raigad district tourism pages do not state a season.

Mumbai to Mandwa vehicle ferry: the operator's two sites showed no readable text, so current sailings, and whether the ferry stops in the monsoon, are not recorded. Search results disagreed on monsoon running.
No source found for a ferry at Rohini, or for whether the creek ferries stop in the monsoon. The operator says only that the Dabhol service runs in all seasons.
Three of the four ferry timetables are images uploaded in 2021 with no date printed; they may be out of date. Fares are left out because the source is the operator, not a government page.
The Atal Setu document carries no printed date; its file name suggests March 2024.
No government order was read for the Mumbai Coastal Road rule.
Goa rules for the last stretch into Panaji are recorded in the file for the Goa, Gokarna and Karnataka coast route.
A landslide at Kashedi Ghat on 2025-07-15 is reported by All India Radio news at https://www.newsonair.gov.in/maharashtra-konkan-receives-heavy-rainfall-traffic-disruption-on-mumbai-goa-highway
Videos: the pages give upload dates, not filming dates, so 'filmed' is filled only where the title names a date. Uploads, in order: 2025-12, 2019-12.
